page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text, with a quotation mark at the end of each line. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Fragment of the facing left page at the far left edge, not transcribed.

main_text.p: non colerentur ab illis Dij, irati his vel alijs cladibus orbem concuterent, ut testatur Cyprianus Epistola 75. his verbis. [Ante viginti & duos fere annos, „ temporibus post Alexandrum Imperatorem: multae conflictationes acciderint, vel in commune omnibus, „ vel privatim Christianis, terraemotus plurimi & frequentes extiterunt; „ ut per Cappadociam, & per Pontum „ multa subruerent, quaedam etiam Civitates in profundo receptae, dirupti „ soli hiatu devorarentur; ex quo persequutio quoque gravis adversus nos „ Christiani nominis facta est, quę post „ longam retro aetatis pacem repente „ oborta, de inopinato & insueto malo „ ad turbandum populum nostrũ terribilior effecta est ; Serenianus tum „ fuit in nostra provincia Praefes acerbus, & dirus persequutor. ] Neque „ certe mirum Serenianum Africae „ Praefectum, in Christianos tam acerbum fuisse, cum ipsum Imperatorem „ Maximinum, (ut in eius vita meminit „ Iulius Capitolinus,) ob summam „ crudelitatem, alij Cyclopem, alij Busi- „ ridem „

page.notes: Quotation marks („) at line ends are printed in the right margin area beside the text; they are transcribed at line ends. A blot over "re" in "temporibus" and over "rator" (ratorem) and "ciderint" hides letters; the readings are conjectural from context but appear legible. Passage in square brackets is a quotation from Cyprian, Epistola 75, as printed. Original spelling retained where it is not a long-s or u/v issue (e.g. "quę", "aduersus" printed as "aduerfus"). Long s has been normalised to s throughout.
